usedFor: Google Forms collects the answers, and HubSpot keeps the contacts. When “New Form Response” arrives in Google Forms, “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot can file the person.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Response” in Google Forms, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It creates the contact or updates the one with the same email, so a person who fills the form twice stays one record. “Create Contact” would not cover that.

watchOut: “New Form Response” is polling, so a response reaches HubSpot after the next check. The contact is matched by email, so the form needs an email question.
